terminology_policy: LA examples are downstream/vendor only; LE replacements are upstream patterns

antipatterns.la_example: LA includes asoc/wcdcal-hwdep.h, asoc/msm-cdc-pinctrl.h, asoc/msm-cdc-supply.h, asoc/bolero-slave-internal.h, linux/qti-regmap-debugfs.h.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: These headers tie the codec driver to vendor frameworks absent in LE kernel.

antipatterns.la_example: LA slave driver adds large debugfs peek/poke/reg_dump surface and direct swr_read/swr_write.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: Debug hooks bypass normal control interfaces and create maintenance/security burden.
antipatterns.le_replacement_pattern: No codec-specific debugfs; rely on standard tracing/regmap debug infrastructure if needed.

antipatterns.la_example: LA identifies slave via string id "wcd938x-slave" and OF compatible qcom,wcd938x-slave.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: LE SDW subsystem expects numeric manufacturer/part tuple for matching.
antipatterns.le_replacement_pattern: Use sdw_device_id with SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY and sdw_driver registration.

antipatterns.la_example: LA slave bind polls swr_get_logical_dev_num with retry loop and usleep.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: Hardcoded polling retries are fragile and board-dependent.
antipatterns.le_replacement_pattern: Use SDW attach/update_status and framework-driven initialization completion.

antipatterns.la_example: LA probe depends on parent platform_data handle/update_wcd_event/register_notifier.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: Parent callback contracts are vendor-specific and not part of LE codec interfaces.
antipatterns.le_replacement_pattern: Use local component data and shared helper libraries without parent callback contracts.

antipatterns.la_example: LA uses msm_cdc_pinctrl_select_* and msm_cdc_*supply helpers for reset and regulator policy.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: Wrapper APIs are not available in LE and encode downstream power policy.
antipatterns.le_replacement_pattern: Use reset-gpios via gpiod and devm_regulator_bulk_get_enable.

antipatterns.la_example: LA consumes qcom,wcd-rst-gpio-node, qcom,rx-slave, qcom,tx-slave, qcom,rx_swr_ch_map, qcom,tx_swr_ch_map, qcom,cdc-micbias*-mv.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: These properties are legacy/vendor conventions and conflict with LE property model.

antipatterns.la_example: LA uses wcd_irq_init/wcd_request_irq/wcd_disable_irq wrappers and private irq_info object.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: Custom wrappers hide irq-domain semantics and increase conversion ambiguity.

antipatterns.la_example: LA suspend/resume toggles buck and supply LPM state via status bits and vendor supply APIs.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: Policy is platform-specific and not directly portable.
antipatterns.le_replacement_pattern: Use runtime PM callbacks and regcache sync path.

antipatterns.la_example: LA carries codec-local MBHC implementation layer (wcd938x-mbhc.c/h) on top of vendor API types.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: Duplicates common behavior already upstream in wcd-mbhc-v2.
antipatterns.le_replacement_pattern: Use shared wcd-mbhc-v2 init/start/stop/deinit and DT parser.

antipatterns.la_example: LA Kbuild depends on target architecture configs and external AUDIO_ROOT build environment.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: Mainline build must be architecture-agnostic and Kconfig-driven.
antipatterns.le_replacement_pattern: Use standard Kconfig symbols and codec Makefile object lists in sound/soc/codecs.

antipatterns.area: Runtime workaround signaling as static truth
antipatterns.la_example: LA includes explicit timing delays for enumeration and PA sequencing that may be board/hardware tuned.
antipatterns.why_not_upstreamable: Static extraction cannot prove these delays are universally required on future codecs/boards.
antipatterns.le_replacement_pattern: Preserve only proven LE lifecycle APIs and mark runtime-sensitive behavior fail-closed.
